# A shellbug: the garden's patrolling critter. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Shell --base-color 0.463 0.259 0.541 --no-slot
material new Spot --base-color 0.843 0.482 0.729 --no-slot
material new Head --base-color 0.133 0.125 0.204 --no-slot
material new BugEye --base-color 0.933 0.765 0.604 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 10 --rings 6 --radius 0.5 --name Shell --location 0 0.04 0.12
scale 0.5 0.56 0.56
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Shell
active Shell
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < -0.02"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --name SpotA --location 0.12 0.0 0.36
scale 0.13 0.15 0.08
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Spot
add mesh ico-sphere --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --name SpotB --location -0.12 0.12 0.33
scale 0.13 0.15 0.08
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Spot
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 8 --rings 5 --radius 0.5 --name Head --location 0 -0.27 0.17
scale 0.26 0.2 0.22
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Head
add mesh cube --size 1 --name EyeR --location -0.065 -0.37 0.21

apply --scale
apply --location

apply --location

add mesh cube --size 1 --name Leg2R --location -0.230 0.200 0.05

apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Head
add mesh cube --size 1 --name Leg2L --location 0.230 0.200 0.05

apply --location

select Shell SpotA SpotB Head EyeR EyeL Leg0R Leg0L Leg1R Leg1L Leg2R Leg2L
